statement: Jelly operator meta has settled; mechanic is extremely time gated and everyone sprinted the first levels then stalled at the same point
Corgon made a Jelly Operator optimizer; find it in the Discord gem chat pins
G3 extra attempts per day (up to plus four) is S tier
H3 Jelly operator linguistics (extra blood cells) is B tier
F3 cellular warfare (straight damage) is A tier
F3 is better than H3 because more damage equals more blood cells and also helps progress further
G3 is necessary to progress this time-gated mechanic in reasonable time; acts as a hard multiplier on blood cell gain per day
Max six attempts per day; base is two uses a day so G3 roughly triples speed
Jelly Operator has strong buffs; 1.4x research EXP gain is amazing
Spelunking power 1.3 buff is amazing
Other buffs include artifact find chance, sushi upgrades, new atom, stealth 3x, drop rate multi, cooking mastery, and plus five Royal Armory upgrades 50% cheaper
Royal Armory 50% cheaper upgrades is permanent and speeds Royal Armory progression; kind of necessary
Jelly Operator is good and so are its nodes in the research grid
Meta setup is a ton of amoebas next to organelle cells with plasmids off to the side
Immunoid is okay at times; may add one once an extra row unlocks but amoeba setup gives most damage and DPS
Pop strong choroid around 40 seconds as you go into overtime or critical overtime
Cold and whatever comes after sepsis is worthless
Go rash over sepsis because rash gives more damage and more damage means more blood cells; sepsis gives less of everything
Rhizome is too slow; better to go triplets first and extra trip from plasmid so amoebas stack faster and kill boss faster
Meta will probably evolve once more cells unlock but players are far from that due to time gating
Next node needed is virus costing 2 trillion; virus might be really good
Breakpoint seems to be 46-47x; front runners are stuck at the next node after Apple
This setup remains the meta for at least the next couple weeks since income can't increase much
If starting, go left side not right side because the right side is bait; take the five-slot nodes first
Right side is bad around or past Apple; hard to unbreak, though the two-by-two is least grief pre-Apple as it lets you place an immunoid
Get the entire left column then keep going left to right
Cells of three (triplets) is meta-defining; build boards around getting triplets
Strong core isn't worth leveling past the first level for now but eventually will be wanted
Meta changes after hitting critical status due to big quantum surge; should get multiple nodes after that
Grab the new arcade node giving extra blood cells (10%); unsure if true multi
World three atom at the bottom for blood cells is easy to max; should reach the 40s and 50s
New gaming palette node Mossy green gives extra damage; level 56 gives only 7% but take all damage
Don't neglect immunoids and ribozones because you want their levels for the upgrade
